the Fermi-Large Area Telescope (LAT) has observed the isotropic diffuse background with a significantly softer spectrum than previously measured by EGRET.

we have shown that the Fermi-Large Area Telescope has already started to probe dark matter annihilation as a possible explanation for the isotropic diffuse background in some scenarios.
